theTwoWereNotOneRoot: They are two jobs and they share nothing: one Vermont family failing ARTIFACTS on a derived-record lag, one Utah family failing PAGE_ORDER and SELF_HELP_STOP on packet content. Different states, different builders, different obligations, different causes. They are reported separately below and were investigated separately.
summary: Neither finding reproduces at the assigned tip, and this lane changed no packet byte in either family. Vermont's ARTIFACTS finding named two things - the product wiring pinning a pre-repair PDF and no central acceptance receipt binding the repaired bytes - and both were corrected between vf35's read base and this tip, in the family's own product-wiring.json and nowhere else: the fixture bytes never moved at all. Utah's PAGE_ORDER and SELF_HELP_STOP were both repaired by commit e621bb5a1, which is an ancestor of this tip; the delivered page sequence now is the packet-set manifest's 1..9 and all eight committed stop conditions are carried verbatim. Both families were rebuilt in a throwaway worktree to prove the committed bytes come from their builders, and both reproduce byte-for-byte. Nothing was written into the delivered tree.

PAGE_ORDER.findingAsWritten: The rendered page manifest does not match the controlling packet-set component order. The packet-set manifest orders BCI application (1), optional third-party release (2), cover sheet (3), petition (4), order (5), acceptance (6), consent (7), victim statement (8), reply (9), then guidance (10). Both rendered PDFs instead place petition and order on pages 1-5, cover sheet on 6-7, forms 6-9 on 8-16, and the BCI components last on 17-19.

proofFitRatherThanTruncation.conclusion: Every page's whitespace-stripped character stream is byte-identical before and after and appears exactly once on each side. No character was added, dropped or truncated; only sequence moved. The permutation is precisely the manifest's order being restored - the two BCI components and the cover sheet lifted from the tail to the head, everything else following in place.
proofFitRatherThanTruncation.digestNote: First 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the whitespace-stripped page text.
